market_view: Risk-on/off mixed: VIX 15.8 after a -11% day, but the 10-year yield is about 5% (WSJ: 'Wall Street Confronts Prospect of a New Era After Treasury Yield Hits 5%') and AI stocks are under pressure. Oil is the dominant macro story with WTI at 100.

oil_gas.catalyst: CNBC: 'U.S. oil tops $105 as Saudi Arabia reportedly cancels some crude cargoes after pipeline closure'; Yahoo Finance: 'Oil prices soar over 4% to 16-week high after Saudi strikes'. A new supply shock on top of the Iran war, not yet fully in XOM, which has lagged crude.
oil_gas.reasoning: Escalation, not de-escalation: the prior condition to extend (WTI above 83, no de-escalation) holds and a fresh Saudi supply shock was added. XOM is up only 2.3% over 5 days versus WTI +9.6%. Extend the hold 10 more days; exit on credible de-escalation.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is below its 200-day average, the 10-year yield is near 5% and rising. NEM headlines (Nevada JV expansion, Argentina project risk) are not one-sided catalysts. NEM is already up 11% in 20 days.

chips.reasoning: Yahoo Finance 'AI Warning Sends Nvidia, AMD, Micron and Intel Shares Tumbling' and the Groq probe are negative; Huang/Trump reassurance headlines are soft. No unpriced positive catalyst.

pharma.reasoning: No LLY-specific headline; FDA approvals listed concern other companies. LLY is down 7.7% in 20 days but oversold is not a catalyst.

copper_uranium.reasoning: No FCX-specific catalyst; the IEA copper supply-gap and BHP Alaska items are long-term and generic. Copper is flat to lower and the uranium ETF is weak.

would_change_my_mind: Credible Iran/Saudi de-escalation or WTI falling back toward 85 would end the XOM long; a named company-specific positive for another leader would add a long.

handoff.what_changed: WTI closed at 100.05 on 09-11 and headlines report US oil above $105 after Saudi strikes and a pipeline closure. The 10-year yield is near 5% and AI stocks fell on an industry warning to slow development. XOM horizon extended on the new Saudi supply shock.
